label: network
description: A network entity representing an observational or research network.

label: campaign
description: A campaign entity representing a coordinated observation, sampling, or data collection activity.

label: satellite
description: A satellite entity representing an Earth observation or spaceborne platform.

label: scenarioId
description: Identifier of the associated scenario.

label: dmpId
description: Identifier of the associated Data Management Plan (DMP).

label: expectedDeliverable
description: Expected deliverable or output associated with the resource.

label: reusedData
description: Identifies external datasets or resources reused by the described resource.

label: generalWPProgram
description: General work programme under which the activity is performed.

label: hasNetwork
description: Links a resource to the associated Network.

label: networkManager
description: Person or organisation responsible for managing the network.

label: ilicoIntegrationYear
description: Year of integration into the ILICO infrastructure.

label: scientificIssues
description: Scientific issues or research challenges addressed.

label: averageNetworkCost
description: Average cost associated with the network.

label: averageDataCost
description: Average cost associated with data acquisition or management.

label: dataNature
description: Describes the nature or type of the data.

label: stability
description: Describes the stability or persistence of the data source.

label: acquisitionMethod
description: Method used to acquire the data.

label: acquisitionFrequency
description: Frequency at which data are acquired.

label: surveyAutomation
description: Level or type of automation used during data collection.

label: dataRecoveryDelay
description: Delay between data acquisition and data availability.

label: validationApproach
description: Approach used for data validation.

label: qualityApproach
description: Approach used for quality assurance and quality control.

label: stationsStudied
description: Number or list of stations included in the study.

label: datasetNumber
description: Number of datasets produced or managed.

label: processingManager
description: Person or organisation responsible for data processing.

label: processingAutomation
description: Level or type of automation used during processing.

label: processingMethod
description: Method used for data processing.

label: preProcessingLevel
description: Pre-processing level applied to the data.

label: analysisAutomation
description: Level or type of automation used during analysis.

label: analysisMethod
description: Method used for data analysis.

label: preAnalysisLevel
description: Pre-analysis processing level applied to the data.

label: postAnalysisLevel
description: Post-analysis processing level applied to the data.

label: hasProductNames
description: Names of products generated from the data or workflow.

label: conservationManager
description: Person or organisation responsible for data conservation or preservation.

label: dataSelectionMethod
description: Method used to select data for preservation or dissemination.

label: fileNamingConvention
description: Naming convention applied to files.

label: supportType
description: Type of storage or preservation support used.

label: dataAccessManager
description: Person or organisation responsible for managing data access.

label: databaseAvailability
description: Availability status of the associated database.

label: dataDisseminationManager
description: Person or organisation responsible for data dissemination.

label: integrityMethods
description: Methods used to ensure data integrity.

label: traceabilityMethods
description: Methods used to ensure data traceability.

label: relatedPublications
description: Publications related to the resource or dataset.

label: hasCampaign
description: Links a resource to the associated Campaign.

label: equipmentUsed
description: Equipment or instruments used during data acquisition.

label: equipmentFailure
description: Description of equipment failures affecting the activity.

label: climateConsidered
description: Indicates whether climatic conditions were considered.

label: modelFailure
description: Description of model failures or limitations.

label: hasSatellite
description: Links a resource to the associated Satellite.

label: hasMission
description: Links a satellite or resource to its associated mission.
